# Recipe portion scaler

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/recipe-scaler/

Scale ingredient amounts from an original yield to a target yield. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Scale a recipe from four portions to six while keeping the entered ingredient units.

## Limits and checks

This scales quantities mathematically. Cooking times, pan size and some ingredients do not scale linearly and need judgment.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
